description: This file defines utility functions and constants for managing role permissions and mappings in Mattermost, including functions to derive roles from mappings, find mapping values from roles, and manipulate role permissions based on predefined mappings.

methods.name: rolesFromMapping
methods.description: Generates a set of roles with updated permissions based on provided mapping values and current roles.

methods.name: mappingValueFromRoles
methods.description: Determines the mapping key value that matches a given set of roles.
